notes: Topline: AccentRyx provides a multi-tenant KB/search layer for mid-market SaaS apps (customer-facing help + in-app search). Evaluating Redwood hosted API for embeddings + inexpensive cross-encoder reranking flow.
Indexing: current baseline ~500k docs (help articles + product guides) across 12 tenants; expecting growth to ~2M docs in 12 months.
Traffic/scale: peak QPS for KB queries ~600 qps (short queries + autocompete), median 180 qps. Concerned about 99p latency during peak windows.
Latency targets: 1) vector retrieval < 40ms, 2) shortlist rerank end-to-end < 150ms for interactive UX. Will accept <=200ms in low-cost plan.
Cost sensitivity: high. Target blended cost per user query <$0.002 (embeddings + reranker amortized). Want config levers: batching, caching, hybrid reranker placement.

Current architecture: client sends user query -> vector search (approx. 50 candidates) -> fast re-ranker (cross-encoder) applied to top 10 -> final result. They currently run re-ranker as CPU-based microservice (slow/costly).
Quoted: 'We need consistent 99th latency under load or we'll lose top-tier customers' (VP Eng on 2026-02-18 call).

POC scope with Redwood: 1) hosted embeddings for stored KB + streaming embedding ops, 2) evaluate Redwood's suggested two-stage pipeline (prefix KV caching + model variants + batching), 3) measure end-to-end cost/latency for reranking by comparing Redwood-hosted cross-encoder vs local microservice.
Security: tenant isolation important. Need encrypted-at-rest, per-tenant key support (KMS), and SSO for admin console. Data residency not hard requirement yet but flagged for EU customers.
Operational needs: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency heatmaps, and alerting on quality regressions for reranker models. Would like automatic recommendations to reduce unit cost.

Eval results (POC v1): - embeddings recall within 1% of baseline, - reranker throughput 3x baseline with Redwood-staging model variant, - median latency 72ms, p99 220ms (investigate batching/shortlist size), - projected monthly cost ~$9k for mid-stage traffic (vs internal projected $13k).
POC feedback: enable longer LRU cache TTL for frequently-accessed KB prefixes; tighten default shortlist size from 50->20 gave 2.8x latency improvement with minimal recall loss on our eval set.
Internal champions: Head of Product (Claire Donovan) + Principal ML Eng (Ravi Patel) are pushing for Redwood; VP Eng (Melissa Ortiz) is skeptical about vendor lock-in.
Sales notes: AE ran through hosted pricing deck (drive link) 2026-02-25; customer requested a custom per-query pricing tier that includes a discounted reranker bundle.
Action items: legal to send MSA redline by 2026-03-17; SE to run stress test (10k qps simulated for 1h) using Redwood-hosted pipeline next week; CSM to schedule onboarding timeline if POC passes.
